findings.quote: Nomex III sample residue after nearly complete concurrent propagation at 15 cm/s on ISS. Flame was shrinking in width until it extinguished within 1 cm of the end of the sample, as its width became smaller than ~ 1 cm, which is on the scale of a fingering flamelet.
findings.about: Nomex III in concurrent flow: spread nearly to the end, then went out as the flame narrowed below about 1 cm
